description: Relocate one uniquely colored symbolic object to one uniquely colored target zone.
prerequisites: The world is a bounded 2D grid.
Object and target colors are unambiguous.
No physical dynamics or obstacles are present.

outputs.episode: episode JSON when storage is configured

procedure: Interpret the source and target colors.
Generate direct and axis-aligned candidate plans.
Simulate and objectively score every candidate.
Execute the highest-scoring candidate in the symbolic world.
Record the evidence as an episode.
known_limits: Does not model obstacles, collisions, geometry, or dynamics.
Requires one matching object and one matching zone.
